ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-intensity (white) mottling is concentrated at the distal tips and along the upper margins of both lobes. The left lobe displays a large, contiguous white patch at its apex, while the right lobe contains more discrete, circular high-intensity clusters scattered across the predominantly dark-pigmented field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp, V-shaped central depression is visible, though the precise vertex coordinate is partially occluded by water spray and turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularity along the trailing edge. Distinct jagged peaks and deep rectangular-to-triangular notches are present, specifically on the medial section of the right lobe and the mid-section of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a strong convex curvature sweeping upwards and outwards, terminating in vertically oriented, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) are localized along the far-left lateral margin and scattered across the mid-ventral regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, cutting through the dark-pigmented areas.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentations on the trailing edge indicative of tissue wear or historical trauma, and heavy barnacle colonization on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jaggedness of the trailing edge topography coupled with dense, asymmetrical barnacle clustering on the far-left lobe tip.
